description:
The day's edition: the briefing's lines by section, each with its countries, who it is about, its score
(the story's main at the edition's home, 0-1) and `mains` (the main at home and at the world), our story page
and the outlet, and what was read for it. With no `edition`, the reader's own (made each morning from their
interests; its `own` note says whether it is ready), else the World edition. `edition` world, pl or us names a
public edition; `date` YYYY-MM-DD (the latest when omitted); `audio` adds the edition read aloud.
name: morning
title: Morning edition
